purpose: Real Government of India travel-allowance and air-travel orders, used as REFERENCE material (authority: reference) for the SPARKS AI Lab corpus. They govern Central Government employees, not SPARKS employees, and never change a SPARKS cap: caps come only from policy_sources/rule_registry.json.
status: Text-only corpus (user decision 2026-11-18): 18 orders with a text layer (8 in batch 1, R27-R36 in batch 2) are kept and ingested as references; 18 scanned orders are excluded (OCR not permitted) and their PDFs were moved to runtime/corpus_excluded/ (not shipped; re-download with scripts.fetch_india_references). Not yet ingested: the corpus route still needs course/Pair A approval.
batch_2: R27-R36 added 2026-11-18 (user: 'gather 10 more documents'): of 83 further orders screened in DoE categories 21, 44, 30 and 29, only 11 had a text layer (one a duplicate); these 10 are the travel-relevant ones. All have a text layer.

https://doe.gov.in/orders-circulars/30 (Foreign Deputation / Delegations / Tours, 23 orders; batch 2)

licence_note: Government of India orders. Copyright Act 1957 s.52(1)(q)(i) permits reproducing matter published in the Official Gazette; not every Office Memorandum is gazetted, so reuse here is for a non-commercial academic capstone with attribution to the issuing department and the official URL. Not legal advice; confirm with the course.
attribution: Source: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India (doe.gov.in), except R01 (copy of the same Department of Expenditure order hosted by the Finance Department, Government of Puducherry, finance.py.gov.in).
